Group.TITLE_GRP: United States - Commercial property price index, all properties
Group.COVERAGE: All commercial properties
Group.DATA_COMP: Starting in Q1 1996, the level index comes from the Costar Commercial Repeat Sales Index. A single, repeat-sales regression equation is used to estimate an index for all commercial properties; therefore, no weights are applied. Series has no flows; data for the most recent ten years show no significant seasonality. Prior to Q1 1996, the level index is a weighted-average of three appraisal-based commercial property prices per square foot series, office property, retail property, and warehouse/industrial property, from NREI. The weights applied to the NREI were calculated using annual data from Current-Cost Net Stock of Private Fixed Assets, Equipment and Software, and Structures, by Type; Structures; Nonresidential structures; line 40, Office, including medical buildings; line 41, Commercial; and line 43, Manufacturing. The weights are not revised. The sum of the weighted indexes is the commercial property price index (rebased by the BIS).

Group.TITLE_GRP: Brazil - Commercial property price index, offices and shop premises, 10 cities
Group.COVERAGE: Property type: office and retail spaces with an area of up to 200 square meters. Listed prices up to BRL 1 million. Geographic coverage: four selected Brazilian cities.
Group.DATA_COMP: Source of price information: offer prices are collected from internet advertisements (seller's asking prices) published on the Zap Imóveis website. The FipeZap Commercial Index is an index of commercial real estate prices (up to 200 square meters), released by the Institute of Economic Research Foundation (Fipe). It is a composite index of price developments for four selected Brazilian cities. The index focuses on commercial offices and retail establishments. The sample is stratified, and the median price per square meter is used for calculations.
Group.BREAKS: The cities of Belo Horizonte and Porto Alegre were incorporated into the index in January 2014 and January 2016, respectively.
Group.TITLE_GRP_NAT: Índice FipeZap de Preços de Imóveis Anunciados (Índice FipeZap) - Comercial
Group.DOC_METHOD: The FipeZap Commercial Index, developed jointly by Fipe and the Zap Imoveis website, is calculated by Fipe based on prices per square meter of commercial properties (commercial offices and commercial retail establishments) up to 200 square meters in four Brazilian cities. Primary price data are collected from internet ads (seller's asking prices). The sample is stratified, and the median price is considered in each stratum. The FipeZap Index is a Laspeyres index of a three-month moving average of median prices. The index methodology is available at https://www.fipe.org.br/pt-br/indices/fipezap#metodologia-do-indice-fipezap
